newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil barges steady to shade higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil barges steady to shade higher.

text.p: European high sulphur fuel oil barges were steady to slightly higher on Wednesday and cargoes were largely unchanged, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges for June traded between $82 and $83.50 fob ARA, compared with a high of $83 on Tuesday. Traders said $84 was done for 1,000 tonnes of July material.

"Only 1,000 tonnes for July was done at $84, it seems to be only as pricing but there was no real July trade today in barges, I guess the market will start to talk July volumes as of tomorrow," one trader said.
Rotterdam bunkers were steady in a very quiet market, with traders saying 380 CST material was priced at $85/86 a tonne and 180 CST at $92/93, while prices in Antwerp were some 50 cents higher.
No fresh trades were heard in high sulphur cargoes but traders said they were still being talked $81 cif after a British major sold on cargo on Tuesday at that number.
A Scandinavian refiner was heard offering at floating prices, high fob plus $1 for utility specification and $2 to $2.50 higher for bunker material.
One percent was still heard offered at $94.50 fob by a U.K. refiner although a trade was heard done on Tuesday at $93.50 fob for 4,000 tonnes bought by an independent trader.
